largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest raw Vegas favorite this week (-390 ML, -7.5 at TEN, ~76.5% no-vig implied). Never the recommendation by policy. The Arbiter shaved it to 0.72 (0-4 own form, L5), below JAX's 0.74, so the recommendation would be JAX either way.

status_note: Strategy run as ELIMINATED (Week 2 loss). No opportunity-cost logic; recommendation = highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded teams. Used: DET, TB, SF, MIN. CAR and KC on bye.
process_note: 10-team shortlist (HOU, JAX, CIN, NE, WAS, DEN, LA, ATL, SEA, PIT, ranked by moneyline since the power-score leaders were thin) went through Advocate -> independent Skeptic subagent -> independent Arbiter subagent, with lessons L1-L11 threaded into all three. L10 set the stricter trap bar (only CIN qualified: own offense compromised plus a key-number move). L5 drove the HOU, WAS and DEN discounts. L7 kept ATL's Lamar-out bump from being stacked. L8 drove NE's drop (four CBs out vs Cousins). All 30 teams playing this week are on the board (L3).

board.summary: The Advocate wins. JAX has the best own form on the board (3-1, +12.8 pd/g). PHI is missing Barkley and Smith, with Hollywood Brown DNP and a makeshift OL, so JAX's banged-up secondary has fewer weapons to worry about. The public-driven 4-point move through the 7, plus a healthy Hurts (L11), justify trimming 2 points off the 0.76 market.
positives: Raw Vegas implied ~0.76 (-380/+300, -7.5); moved from -3.5 toward JAX
JAX 3-1 at +12.8 pd/g (prior +7.5); won 22-17 at CIN
PHI 2-2 at -4.5 pd/g; RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith OUT
PHI DNP: WR Hollywood Brown, EDGE Greenard, S Epps, C Kendall; Baun, Goedert, T Fred Johnson limited
negatives: Line move driven by ~75-82% public tickets and money, so the price may be inflated
International trip right after a road game at CIN, no bye
JAX secondary banged up: four CBs limited, S Eric Murray in concussion protocol; RT Harrison limited
Jalen Hurts healthy (L11); PHI get-right spot (soft)

board.summary: The market and the steam toward HOU are real, and TEN is bad on every measure. But HOU is 0-4 at -6.2 pd/g and gave up 34 at home (L5).
